name: riso colour-flicker claim into a pivot question
looks: A small circle holds one bold claim, then the same short claim flashes through four quick ink-colour swaps on a striped halftone card before settling hard on one final combination. A pink dot-matrix field pulls in with a highlighted pivot word, and the shot lands on one big question mark over a short line asking how long a single piece of work really takes.
build: The riso-print-flicker mechanic: a DOM card swaps its two-colour background and type ink on a hard cut every 0.15-0.2 s through a short palette list, holding the final combination. The pivot card is a dot-matrix background with a highlighted label box popping in; the question card is a large DOM glyph under a bold two-line claim.
sound: A fast paper-flutter rattle through the colour flicker landing on a thunk, a soft tap as the pivot label pops in, a low held tone under the question mark.
prompt: Open on a bold claim that flashes through a handful of quick ink-colour swaps on a textured, print-like card before settling hard on one final combination, then pivot through a short 'but' beat on a dot-matrix field into one big question mark asking how long a piece of creative work really takes.
